hub.heading: Hospital Events & Calendar
hub.lede: Hospital events, awareness campaigns, and the annual observance calendar at Hijaz Hospital.

hospitalEvents.title: Dengue Awareness Walk 2026
hospitalEvents.shortDescription: Community awareness walk and educational session on dengue prevention led by hospital leadership and staff.

content.text: Hijaz Hospital staff and community members participated in a dengue awareness walk followed by an educational briefing on symptoms, prevention, and early treatment.
Medical Superintendent Dr. Arfan Ishaque addressed participants on the importance of community vigilance during peak mosquito season.

meta.title: Dengue Awareness Walk 2026 | Hijaz Hospital Events
meta.description: Dengue awareness walk and education session at Hijaz Hospital.

hospitalEvents.title: Paramedics Annual Farewell Dinner
hospitalEvents.shortDescription: Annual farewell dinner for graduating paramedic students at Haji Inam Elahi School of Paramedics.

content.text: The Haji Inam Elahi School of Paramedics hosted its Annual Farewell Dinner, celebrating graduating students and their commitment to healthcare service.

meta.title: Paramedics Farewell Dinner 2026 | Hijaz Hospital Events
meta.description: Annual farewell dinner for paramedic graduates.

hospitalEvents.title: Free Medical Camp — Sheikhupura
hospitalEvents.shortDescription: Outreach medical camp with free consultations, diagnostics, and medicines.

content.text: Hijaz Hospital's welfare outreach team conducted a free medical camp in Sheikhupura with multi-specialty consultations and free medicines for deserving patients.
